map.停车配比计算器：按建筑类型配建标准计算停车位数量与面积，并含无障碍车位要求，用于: The parking ratio calculator computes the number and area of parking spaces from the provisioning standard for the building type, including accessible space requirements, for planning and application review.
map.建设工程规划许可前，按建筑类型与城市规模查\"配建停车位指标\"，计算应配建车位: Before a construction planning permit, look up the "parking space provisioning indicator" by building type and city size, then compute required spaces = building scale / unit x indicator.
map.住宅、办公、商业、酒店、医院、学校、文体场馆、公园等配建口径不同（按户/按建筑面: The provision standards for housing, offices, retail, hotels, hospitals, schools, stadiums and parks all differ (per household / per 100 m2 of floor area / per bed or seat).
map.在总车位中拆分无障碍车位（≥2%）与访客车位（按比例），并估算停车面积。: Split accessible spaces (at least 2%) and visitor spaces (by ratio) out of the total, and estimate the parking area.
map.配建指标按什么口径取值？: What basis are the provisioning indicators taken on?
map.住宅按\"户\"、办公/商业/医院按\"建筑面积（每 100 m²）\"、酒店按: Housing is counted per household, offices/retail/hospitals per 100 m2 of floor area, hotels per room count, schools per 100 students, stadiums and venues per 100 seats, and parks per 1000 m2 of land. The indicators decrease in order for megacity / large city / medium city / small city (for example housing 1.0/0.8/0.6/0.5).
map.无障碍停车位数量一般不少于总车位的 2%（且不少于 1 个），应靠近出入口、地面: Accessible parking spaces are generally not less than 2% of total spaces (and not fewer than 1), should be near entrances and on the ground. Visitor spaces are listed separately by ratio and do not count as accessible spaces.
